_comment: Default weights, percentage points, must sum to 100. Sector files may add deltas; code renormalizes to 100.

time_saved.definition: Monthly volume x minutes per task. More hours saved = higher score.

volume_repetitiveness.definition: How often the task happens and how similar each occurrence is.

error_risk_inverse.definition: Inverse of the damage if AI gets it wrong. Low impact = high score (safer to automate).

ease_of_implementation.definition: Data availability and integration effort. Digital data and common tools = high score.
